text:
maya singh: Quick pitch  run a focused PLG micro-test 'bootstrap-loop'  launch posts + tiny webinar + credit seeding + immediate prompt-run CTA. Goal: boost 3-day prompt-run rate. Thoughts?
cole atwood: Solid. Keep n small: 800 impressions, seed 180 users with 15 credits. Two email subjects and a creative split (code screenshot vs short clip). Who owns cohort tagging?
maya singh: @cole can do routing & tagging. @nina do copy. I'll handle webinar ops.
cole atwood: Routing pseudocode I'll implement: 
```
if (utm_campaign == 'bootstrap_loop' && source in ['twitter','hn']) {
  user.meta.cohort = 'bootstrap_loop_v1';
  emit('bootstrap.credited');
}
```
I'll expose cohort_id `bootstrap_loop_v1` and tag users on grant.
nina ford: Copy direction: practical + low-friction. Lead with "15 credits + 3 starter prompts". Subject A: "15 credits to try Redwood templates" Subject B: "Ship a demo with 15 free credits" Social caps short, include `?utm_campaign=bootstrap_loop`.
drew park: Landing ask: minimal success page with a preselected starter prompt and a big "Run this prompt" button. Also inline calendar for the 20-min webinar. I can push a one-page variant to staging.
planner-bot: Note: campaign schedules require 48h lead time. Confirm start date accordingly.
maya singh: Timeline: prep Tue, soft launch Wed 10am PT -> 800 impressions, measure 72h, webinar Thur 11am PT (15-min demo + Q). Decision rule: if prompt-run lift > 14% vs baseline, scale to 7k impressions.
cole atwood: Tech notes: credit grant via feature flag `bootstrap_seed_v1`. I'll open a tiny PR and ensure analytics surfaces cohort_id.
nina ford: I'll draft two social posts + two email variants and 3 starter prompts. Will include a one-click "Run this prompt" CTA on success page. Drafts in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
drew park: Also propose a short in-app survey after prompt-run: "Was this helpful? y/n". Tie negatives to a follow-up onboarding nudge.
maya singh: Metrics: signup -> prompt-run (24h), first API call, avg tokens in first session, webinar RSVPs -> attendance. Pause credits if prompt-run < 30% after 48h.
cole atwood: Opening PR now for routing + credit flag.
planner-bot: Scheduled check created for 48 hours prior to 2024-07-01T10:00:00Z.
maya singh: OK go-ahead. Seed 180 users x 15 credits. Keep it lean. If green, roll up next week. Thanks team! :rocket:
